## What changes and why



## Checklist

- [ ] Tests for what it changes (`bun run check`, and `bun run test:docs` for the site or React)
- [ ] A changeset if a published package changes (`bun run changeset`)
- [ ] New docs words in all five languages (PT, EN, ES, FR, DE)
- [ ] No value written outside the tokens, and no component HTML written twice (see AGENTS.md)
